$Comment: The game's own Small Christmas Packet at Santa's stall, a small chest that holds things, for a player who wants to wrap a gift of their own and leave it for a friend. The title is the item's own name key, written in full (server.items.<Id>.name) so the stall shows the name the item shows in the bag; the item has no description key, so the offer has no line under it. The red packet sells for festival tokens on the festival shelf the stall also carries.
